OVF Server Explorer -- install instructions (KNIME 5.x)
========================================================

Adds a Server Explorer view to KNIME that browses a remote HTTP
workflow share or a local filesystem mount. This is NOT an official
KNIME product; it is a third-party plugin under the org.ovf.* namespace.

This build targets KNIME 5.x (Java 17 runtime). For KNIME 4.1.x use
the 4.1.x zip instead.

Contents of this zip:
  serverconnector/
    plugins/
      org.ovf.serverconnector_@BUNDLE_VERSION@.jar

After install the plugin lives at:
  <knime-install>/dropins/serverconnector/plugins/org.ovf.serverconnector_@BUNDLE_VERSION@.jar


-----------------------------------------------------------------
Preferred: Install via Archived Update Site (all OSes)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

An Eclipse p2 update-site zip is also published:

    ovf-serverconnector-5.x-@VERSION@-updatesite.zip

Or a live URL if you host one:

    http://<host>/5x/    (e.g., http://updatesite.example.com/5x/)

Use either with KNIME's built-in installer:

  1. In KNIME:  File > Install KNIME Extensions...   (or)
                Help > Install New Software...
  2. Click "Add..." next to the "Work with:" dropdown.
  3. Either "Archive..." + pick the updatesite zip, or paste the URL
     into the Location field. Name it "OVF Server Explorer" and Add.
  4. Expand the "OVF" category, check the feature, Next, accept the
     license, Finish. Restart when prompted.


-----------------------------------------------------------------
Alternative: dropin (Linux / macOS)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. Quit KNIME Analytics Platform.

2. Find your KNIME install directory -- the folder that contains
   knime / KNIME.app, knime.ini, plugins/ and (often) dropins/.

3. Extract the zip into the dropins/ folder. From a terminal:

       cd <knime-install>/dropins
       unzip /path/to/ovf-serverconnector-5.x-@VERSION@.zip

   (If dropins/ doesn't exist, create it: mkdir dropins)

4. Launch KNIME once with -clean so the plugin cache picks up the
   new bundle:

       <knime-install>/knime -clean


-----------------------------------------------------------------
Alternative: dropin (Windows)
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. Quit KNIME Analytics Platform.

2. Find your KNIME install directory. Common locations:
     C:\Program Files\KNIME\         (MSI installer -- needs admin)
     C:\Users\<you>\KNIME\           (user install)

3. Extract ovf-serverconnector-5.x-@VERSION@.zip. Right-click > Extract
   All... to any folder. You'll get a serverconnector\ folder.

4. Move that serverconnector\ folder into
   <knime-install>\dropins\ so the layout is:

       <knime-install>\dropins\serverconnector\plugins\org.ovf.serverconnector_@BUNDLE_VERSION@.jar

5. Launch KNIME once with -clean:

       cd "C:\Program Files\KNIME"
       knime.exe -clean

   Or right-click the KNIME shortcut > Properties, append ` -clean`
   to the Target field, launch once, then remove it.


-----------------------------------------------------------------
Verify
-----------------------------------------------------------------

The view co-stacks as a tab next to "KNIME Explorer" in the Modeller
perspective. After launch:

  - Look at the pane that shows "KNIME Explorer" on the left.
    There should be a second tab labelled "Server Explorer".
  - If the pane is too narrow to show both tabs, widen it or click
    the ">>" overflow chevron in the tab bar.

If the tab isn't there, force it in:

  Window > Show View > Other... > KNIME Views > Server Explorer

If you installed via the update site (not dropin) and the tab still
isn't showing, the perspective may need to pick up the new view
extension:

  Window > Perspective > Reset Perspective...  (5.x)
    -- or --
  Close and reopen the Modeller perspective.

Configure your server URL under:
  File > Preferences > KNIME > OVF > Servers


-----------------------------------------------------------------
Uninstall
-----------------------------------------------------------------

If installed via the update site:
  Help > About KNIME > Installation Details >
    select "OVF Server Explorer" > Uninstall...

If installed via dropin:
  Quit KNIME, then delete:
    <knime-install>/dropins/serverconnector
  Restart KNIME with -clean once.
